name: Hi Nichijou Quartet
source:
Yumikiri Shia was bored with her everyday life. But, with the coming of that new student, she became interested in him and that life started to change.

From an normal everyday life, to an extraordinary everyday life.

[based on [url=http://watercolors.sakura.ne.jp/games/kua.htm]official site[/url]]
